Templates load into an injectable *fabrikweb.Templates; a provider returning
web.FuncMap supplies the static helpers, appended to the generated Load call.

-- main.go --
package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- web/templates.go --
package web

import "embed"

//fabrik:web:templates
//go:embed all:templates
var Templates embed.FS
-- shared/helpers.go --
package shared

import (
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"
)

//fabrik:provider
func NewTemplateFuncs() web.FuncMap {
	return web.FuncMap{
		"humanizeAge": func(t time.Time) string { return t.String() },
		"upper":       strings.ToUpper,
	}
}
-- web/templates/_default/_layout.html --
<html><body>{{ block "content" . }}{{ end }}</body></html>
-- web/templates/_default/home.html --
{{ define "content" }}<h1>{{ upper .Title }}</h1>{{ end }}
-- web/web.go --
package web

import (
	"net/http"

	fabrikweb "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"
)

type Handlers struct {
	Templates *fabrikweb.Templates
}

//fabrik:http GET /
func (h *Handlers) Home(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	h.Templates.Render(w, "home", "", map[string]string{"Title": "hi"})
}
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/router"
	web2 "github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/web"

	"app/shared"
	"app/web"
)

func run() int {
	if err := func() (err error) {
		// Providers
		r := router.New()
		sharedWebFuncMap := shared.NewTemplateFuncs()
		webTemplates, err := web2.LoadTemplates(web.Templates, "templates", sharedWebFuncMap)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		webHandlers := &web.Handlers{
			Templates: webTemplates,
		}

		// Register
		r.Method("GET", "/", webHandlers.Home)
		return nil
	}(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "app:", err)
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
